ui_idle_hint: Danna alamar tsawaitawa don taƙaita wannan shafi.
ui_truncated: Wannan shafi yana da tsawo; sashen farko kawai aka taƙaita.
error_page_unreadable: Ba za a iya karanta wannan shafi ba. Ba a tallafa wa shafukan mai bincike da Chrome Web Store ba.
error_no_content: Ba a sami rubutun maƙala a wannan shafi ba.
error_needs_click: Danna alamar tsawaitawa don taƙaita wannan shafi. Bayan shafin ya koma wani shafi, tsawaitawar tana buƙatar sabon dannawa don karanta shi.
error_host_missing: Ba a shigar da ɓangaren gida ba ko kuma ba ya amsawa. A cikin jakar tsawaitawar, gudanar da: ./native-host/install.sh
error_claude_missing: Ba a sami Claude Code ba. Shigar da shi, sannan ka sake gudanar da ./native-host/install.sh
error_claude_auth: Ba ka shiga Claude Code ba. Gudanar da claude a cikin tasha ka shiga.
error_codex_signed_out: Ba ka shiga Codex ba. Gudanar da codex login a cikin tasha.
error_codex_not_eligible: Ba za a iya amfani da tsarin ChatGPT ɗinka don wannan ba. Zaɓi wani mai bayarwa.
error_usage_limit: Ka kai iyakar amfani na tsarinka. Sake gwadawa daga baya ko ka zaɓi wani mai bayarwa.
error_provider_failed: Mai bayarwa ya kasa yayin rubuta taƙaitawar. Sake gwadawa.
error_codex_missing: Ba a sami Codex ba. Shigar da shi, sannan ka sake gudanar da ./native-host/install.sh
options_help: Taƙaitawa na wucewa ta ɓangaren gida a wannan kwamfuta: yana gudanar da Claude Code ko Codex da biyan kuɗinka, ko wani samfuri a cikin Ollama. Ana aika rubutun shafin ga mai bayarwar da ka zaɓa kawai.
ui_ask_placeholder: Yi tambaya game da wannan shafi
error_ollama_missing: Ollama ba ya aiki a wannan kwamfuta. Shigar da shi daga ollama.com ka buɗe shi, sannan ka sake gwadawa.
error_ollama_model_missing: Ba a sauke wannan samfurin a cikin Ollama ba. Gudanar da ollama pull tare da sunan samfurin (misali, ollama pull llama3.2), sannan ka sake gwadawa.
options_models_never: Ba a karanta jerin samfura ba tukuna.
options_models_auto: Suna fitowa daga Claude Code, Codex da Ollama, kuma ana sake karanta su sau ɗaya a rana, lokacin da aka sabunta Claude Code ko Codex, da kuma lokacin da aka sabunta tsawaitawar.
error_file_access: Don taƙaita fayiloli a wannan kwamfuta, buɗe Bayanai na tsawaitawar a chrome://extensions kuma kunna Ba da damar shiga URL na fayil.
error_pdf_unreadable: Ba za a iya buɗe wannan PDF ba. Wataƙila an kare shi da kalmar sirri ko ya lalace.
error_pdf_no_text: Wannan PDF ba shi da rubutun da za a taƙaita. Wataƙila an yi shi ne da hotunan da aka duba (scan).
history_empty: Babu taƙaitawa tukuna. Za su bayyana a nan yayin da kake yin su.
history_no_results: Babu taƙaitawar da ta dace da binciken.
error_no_transcript: Wannan bidiyon ba shi da rubutaccen bayani (transcript) da za a taƙaita. YouTube yana da shi ne kawai idan bidiyon yana da fassarar rubutu ko taken rubutu na atomatik.
options_styles_help: Salo yana ƙara umarni ga taƙaitawa, misali: Taƙaita shi a matsayin zaren gajerun saƙonni uku.
